| Page | Lanes | Deployments | Points | Hardware |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| GLM-5.2 | 14 | 34 | 75 | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200 |
| GLM-5.3 | 1 | 1 | 10 | B300 |

| DeepSeek-V4.1 | 9 | 22 | 67 | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200, H100 |
| Qwen3.5 | 16 | 51 | 220 | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200, H100 |
| Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | 4 | 5 | 24 | GB300, B300, B200, H200 |
| Muse Spark Open | 8 | 11 | 72 | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200 |

- Every page in a headless browser (`mint dev`, Mintlify as in CI). Every hardware / checkpoint / deployment / concurrency / KV tier / router combination renders exactly the decoded commands: 3,216 command sets, 0 mismatches, 0 unseen, no browser errors. Every tab was clicked, and every "Copy link" URL was reopened. The section links from the Deployment panels and the copy buttons were also checked.
- The component's own decoder reproduces every generated plan (3,216 router × KV-tier variants). Every KV flag exists in its image's SGLang commit (247 image × flag pairs). The round-trip / leak check reports 0 problems.
- **Arg-parse in the submission images:** all 70 commands not validated in an earlier round parse with their image's own parsers (`dev-minimax-m31-flash`: 68, `v0.5.19-cu130`: 2).
